comment: TROYAN'S MANA CANNOT PAY A SMALL SPELL (Bruna sideboard, 2026-10-06; negative guard). Unflinching Courage ({1}{G}{W}, MV 3) on Mother of Runes would make her 3/3 -- lethal at 3 -- but beyond Forest + Plains the only mana is Troyan's {G}{U}, spendable only on a spell of mana value 5+ (mana_only_spell_min_mv). The draw is an uncastable Eldrazi Conscription (no land drop). Must NOT win on turn 4: Mother 1 + Troyan 1 = 2 < 3. Fails if the restriction is dropped anywhere on the path (enumerator offer + payer).
